body: Founder: 'ensure my avatar can move around town and the location is persisted so login to same spot.' Found and fixed a real gap: town_sync_position was throttled to once per 2s, so a player who moved and quit within that window lost their last few steps. Added a force param, called once at shutdown to flush pending movement. Live-verified end-to-end: forced movement + quit at 800ms (under the throttle) still persisted the partial position (2.383, 0, 1.589); a fresh second launch loaded from exactly that spot, confirming real session-to-session persistence. GoblinFoxDragon 3ae38ff.
title: Town position sync flushes on quit -- true login-to-same-spot
